title: Condensation on glass
description: Backlit droplets on a cold window, first light coming through.
attribution: the day still undecided, seen through a fogged window

title: Dew on grass
description: Every blade beaded overnight, each drop holding a tiny inverted sky.
attribution: gone by nine — you have to be up for it

title: Torn croissant
description: Shattered lamination, butter in a hundred glass-thin layers.
attribution: the texture of a morning with nowhere to be

title: Rumpled linen
description: Sheets holding the shape of sleep in early side-light.
attribution: soft topography — the first thing the sun touches

title: Sun-bleached concrete
description: Hard shadows, zero gradient — the flattest light of the day.
attribution: midday honesty: nothing hidden, nothing softened

title: Watermelon flesh
description: Cold pink grid with black seeds, cut side up on a hot day.

title: Pool water caustics
description: White light nets flexing over turquoise.
attribution: the pattern that only exists when the sun is straight overhead

title: Backlit lemon slice
description: Pith and pulp lit from behind like stained glass.

title: Brushed brass
description: Warm metal catching low-angle light along its grain.
attribution: a metal that only comes alive in low light

title: Backlit wheat
description: A field of awns catching the last low sun, every stalk haloed.
attribution: Monet built whole paintings out of this exact glow

title: Terracotta in raking light
description: Fired clay, every ridge and thumbprint thrown into relief.
attribution: holds the day's heat long after the sun drops

title: Honey in glass
description: Slow amber pour, light trapped mid-fall.
attribution: the exact color of the hour, pourable

title: Crushed velvet
description: Deep blue pile shifting between light and shadow as it folds.
attribution: dusk in fabric form — the blue hour you can touch

title: Vinyl grooves
description: Macro shot of record grooves under a single lamp.
attribution: music you can see — the physical middle of the night

title: Streetlight on wet asphalt
description: Sodium-orange glow doubled in the road after rain.
attribution: the whole city repainted for whoever is still out

title: Moonlight on black water
description: A path of broken silver across still water.
attribution: a road you can't take, pointed straight at you

title: Dark chocolate snap
description: Matte surface, clean break, faint gloss on the fracture line.
attribution: bitter, precise, best after everyone else is asleep
